description: Insert one or more records into a database table. Each record is a JSON object mapping column names to values. Returns the inserted records (with auto-generated fields like IDs) if the database supports RETURNING. Requires POST permission on the table.

records.description: Array of record objects to insert (e.g. [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}])

table.description: Name of the table to insert into

name: faucet_insert
